summary: Innate Pharma S.A. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, US equivalent of an 8-K/press release) reporting first-half 2026 results and business updates. Disclosures include a strategic partnership with Sobi for lacutamab that closed September 16, 2026 after antitrust clearance, with a $75 million upfront payment; initiation of the TELLOMAK-3 Phase 3 trial; and a completed 30 million equity financing. Cash was 21.4 million at June 30, 2026, with runway into Q1 2028. No special-situation transaction terms or board recommendation are stated.
